_texts.01-hook: Your agent obeys every skill it installs.
_texts.02-threat: So one hidden line can make it leak your keys.
_texts.03-list: Authena is a list on Kleros Curate. Publishers stake that a skill is clean. Anyone can challenge it.
_texts.04-judge: GenLayer validators read the file, check the quote, and rule. Kleros pays the winner.
_texts.05-live: Thirteen skills went through it live. The sneaky ones got busted. The honest ones stayed listed.
_texts.06-product: Paste any skill link, or let your agent check first.
_texts.07-cta: Authena. Check the skill before your agent does.
